text: Center Township is located in Clinton County, Iowa, United States. As recorded in the 2000 census, the township had a population of 626. It was organized in 1852. The township spans an area of 42.42 square miles (109.9 km²) and does not contain any incorporated settlements. According to the U.S. Geological Survey, it includes two cemeteries: Center Grove and Elvira.
